repairs.detail: Create the native expanded class token on the input device instead of forcing CUDA. A non-1024 input_dim changes only the first learned projection; native 512-dimensional TransMIL layers remain intact.
Load the real ILRA/GAB/NLP modules directly from models, avoiding the unrelated Lightning training package initializer.

Make the native input projection honor mlp_dim instead of hardcoding 512, matching the encoder and predictor dimensions. For pool=avg, apply the native AdaptiveAvgPool1d over the token axis by transposing [B,N,D] to [B,D,N] and squeezing its singleton pooled axis. Both R-MSA and cross-region MSA remain native. The feature-bag API supports positional modes none, peg and ppeg; sincos is rejected early because its pinned implementation expects four-dimensional region geometry, not a feature bag.

Preserve native instance/global-lesion encoders and cross-attention, momentum-updated positive/normal centers, and lesion embeddings. Expose centers and embeddings for the upstream alignment/diversity training objectives; no shared loss schedule is imposed.
Import native CAPRMIL and soft clustering transformer blocks directly, avoiding unrelated training dependencies.
Use native Lin_MIL, Config, linear transformer blocks, classifier and attention output. The default linear attention path runs on CPU without flash-attention or xformers.
Export only the three native Mamba/SRMamba/BiMamba blocks; do not eagerly import language-model/triton training dependencies.

Replace compiled selective-scan and fused-inner-operation imports with differentiable Torch causal depthwise convolution, input projections, fp32 selective recurrence, D skip, SiLU gate and output projection. Preserve SRMamba's native fast-path sequence transpose, zero padding and inverse transpose: do not select its broken, mathematically different slow branch. Correct the optional causal-convolution import fallback from a single None to a pair of None values. This exact reference is slower than fused CUDA kernels and keeps the training recurrence autograd graph.
Squeeze the pooled singleton token dimension rather than the batch dimension. Native attention pooling and classifier remain intact; this adapter profile exposes classification.

Use population variance/std (correction=0) for evaluation-window dispersion so one window has zero uncertainty instead of NaN. Preserve native training feature-channel sampling and deterministic overlapping evaluation windows. Direct leaf import avoids the upstream package's uppercase nnMIL import mismatch.

Preserve the native student, teacher attention masks and distillation loss. Adapt the input projection to explicit input_dim/mlp_dim, use integer deterministic mask indices, retain at least one patch, and omit the unsupported no_norm keyword for native self-attention inference.
Skip eager unrelated CLAM/Mamba/trainer imports, importing the actual MHIM and mhim_modules implementations directly.

Supply identity patch indices when masking is disabled; make disabled merging accept the native attention argument; preserve singleton feature/token axes in class-aware scoring; retain at least one patch; use integer deterministic mask indices; register the frozen global query at momentum=1 and preserve its alias; keep at least one input token available for merge cross-attention. Native merge EMA and attention remain active.

Keep a frozen eval-mode deep copy of the native student in state_dict, with reset_teacher/update_teacher/after_optimizer_step hooks and update counter. Teacher updates are explicit, apply once to shared parameter aliases, and accept a caller-supplied momentum schedule. As in the upstream coordinator, the v2 teacher does not use test-time merging. Auxiliary distillation losses remain gradient-preserving student tensors.

For baseline=dsmil expose the native bag classifier logits as the standard logits, and preserve the native maximum-instance head in aux.max_instance_logits, per-class pooled representations in aux.class_embeddings, and the averaged head probabilities in aux.ensemble_probabilities. Both heads remain trainable for the native two-head objective. Forward the configured class count into v1's DSMIL constructor and unpack its three-value attention inference result. Preserve native DSMIL masking, teacher attention and class-feature distillation.
